required_fixes: Provide real LLM API key (OPENAI_API_KEY or equivalent) in execution environment — hard blocker per spec.json measurement_validity #4 and #8: tokens = sum(prompt_tokens+completion_tokens) from real LLM API responses and repair LLM must be real model not heuristic (gpt-4o-mini, temperature 0.0, max 15 steps). Without key, gates C1, C2, C4, C5, C6, C7, C8 cannot be measured. This is retryable infrastructure, not scientific falsification per EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md s9.

Deploy real nginx 1.2x reverse-proxy with proxy_cache configured for HIT/SWR/SIE/304 stages and Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT HS256 backend + SQLite fixture matching runtime substrate EXP-RUNTIME-35611612543 and EXP-RUNTIME-35741906498. Record nginx.conf hash, Flask testbed_server.py commit, decompression code hash, nginx --version, Python 3.12.14, Playwright 1.63.0, openai version. Verify >=0.99 SHA256(decompressed_body) identity HIT==SWR==SIE==304 pre-perturbation via oracle-free gzip.decompress on real nginx responses with non-vacuous full>body and full>status discrimination (B-RUNTIME-BYTE-IDENTITY gate C3) per agent prior #5.

Implement real repair agent pipeline (execute_delta_repair_real.py) with real LLM calls (record model id gpt-4o-mini, temperature, max_tokens, provider, per-call token counts, 15-step budget), real Playwright execution (goto/click/fill/evaluate/fetch with trace logs), and real verify() on actual DOM/response state (selector existence via Playwright evaluate, status/header/body match) with independent oracle for false accepts (ground-truth from perturbation manifest). No hardcoded constants (COLD_TOKENS_BASE 2250, retrieval 320, verify 180, heuristic 1364 removed per spec) and no deterministic instance_id-derived perfect-separation verification scores; threshold calibrated on TRAIN only.

Execute frozen sampling plan exactly as preregistered: >=48 perturbation instances (3 families F-DOM/F-ENDPOINT/F-CACHE x2 variants x8 seeds) with N>=24 unrelated mechanisms for contamination, family-stratified TRAIN24/TEST24 split (TRAIN seeds 0-3, TEST seeds 4-7 per variant), registry clone isolation, cache purge per instance, perturbation manifest holdout (never in repair prompt), verification operating threshold fit on TRAIN only, trajectory-grouped resampling unit = instance/trajectory block.

Compute all frozen metrics on TEST only with trajectory-grouped uncertainty and apply frozen decision rule C1-C8 exactly without threshold weakening: M-repair_success_rate Wilson 95% CI pooled+per-family, M-repair_tokens_ratio_vs_cold and M-browser_ratio_vs_cold instance-block bootstrap 2000 resamples 95% CI, M-verification_auroc (DeLong + block-permutation) / M-verification_precision/recall, M-contamination_rate/M-false_accept_rate block-permutation, M-amortized_cost_tokens_10/M-amortized_cost_browser_10 vs M-cold_cost, M-byte_identity_hit_swr_sie_304_sha_match_rate pre/post via real nginx oracle-free decode, M-retrieval_cost_tokens (real), M-replay_success_rate/M-retrieval_success_rate, and gate evaluation C1 PC1=1.0 PC2>=0.90, C2 NC1 cost0 cont0 FA<=5% AUROC 0.4-0.6, C3 >=0.99, C4 >=0.80 pooled >=0.70 per-family, C5 <0.50 tokens <0.40 browser steps<=2, C6 <0.10, C7 AUROC>=0.75 precision>=0.80, C8 amortized < cold. If pooled TEST n<24 report MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Correct provenance freeze_json_sha256 to real hash 8abd55688204d6b094c30feaa34c2aec235725df9f24310ab98bcc2b3160f192.
